description: This file is a shell script for testing git tag verification, including signing, signature verification, and formatting features. It contains test cases for various scenarios such as signed tags, unsigned tags, signature verification with different trust levels, and raw signature output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the test commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if the command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns within output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies configuration options for tests.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's timestamp or progress the test environment.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Indicates the end of the test script.
